en: How to Play Hanetsuki Hell!{KP}It's intense hanetsuki training!{KP}Hit back the shuttlecocks the oni launch with the Circle button!{KP}Your score depends on the color of the shuttlecock you hit back!{KP}Hold the Circle button down, then let go quickly to smash!{KP}Smashing is an advanced technique, and you'll get hooked on it!{KP}The points are off the charts too! If you can smash, you're a pro!{KP}And if a shuttlecock hits you, you can't move for a while!{KP}No whining! Endure the training, and then more training!

Hanetsuki Hell! Here's how the versus game works!{KP}A grueling game where Momotaro-san and Kintaro-san battle on the same court!{KP}Hit back the shuttlecocks the oni launch with the Circle button!{KP}Hold the Circle button down, then let go quickly to smash!{KP}Land a smash and a washtub drops on your opponent!{KP}Get in your opponent's way and score as many points as you can!{KP}1P is Momotaro-san, and 2P is Kintaro-san!
